::: {.fi-standfirst}
Science knows a great deal about health, and almost none of it reaches the person
making an actual decision in a form they can use. **FRESH** is an attempt at the
missing piece: take what the evidence actually supports, make it personal and
honest, and say plainly how sure anyone can be. Not disease management. Health.

Ask where to go for guidance that is accurate and usable at the same time and there
is no good answer. A doctor has accuracy for medicine, the training to read the
science, and fifteen minutes, and a life does not fit inside a clinic. A dietitian
knows how to turn food into a recommendation but rarely has any measurement to work
from. The internet has the engagement and gets paid by the click. So belief gets
built somewhere else: at dinner, in the answer you give a child who asks why one
cereal is better than another, in the headline you half-read. Nobody stands outside
that, and nobody has ever been paid to fix it. So I started building it. The longer
version is on [what we're doing](about.qmd).
:::
